plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The dataset is a raw integer gene-level count matrix (12000 genes x 12 samples, gene symbols as rows) from Salmon, with metadata naming 6 atopic-dermatitis-lesional ('treated') vs 6 control skin samples, unpaired, single batch. The research question asks which genes and which hallmark pathways change between treated and control. The pipeline is the standard two-group count workflow: sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA, sample distances, library sizes), with sample_01 — whose library size is ~4x below the median — kept, inspected and reported, not silently dropped (its depth is handled by the size factor; removal requires a stated reason). Then a minimal low-count pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), median-of-ratios normalization inside the model, a DESeq2 Wald test on ~condition with control as the explicit reference level, apeglm log2FC shrinkage, and BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering. The counts arrive already aggregated to gene level (no transcript-level quant files are present), so tximport length offsets are not applicable; the DESeq2 gene-count model is the available path and this is stated in the report. Because edgeR QL is the designated robustness companion at 6 replicates per group, an edgeR quasi-likelihood run reports the overlap with the DESeq2 calls as the high-confidence gene set. Hallmark pathways are read out with fgsea preranked on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list of all tested genes against the MSigDB Hallmark collection (2026.1, human), with WikiPathways human (2026.07.10) as the second collection; Reactome is not staged in this environment and its absence is reported. Counts use HGNC symbols and the Hallmark GMT uses HGNC symbols, so the two share one identifier space; any mapping loss and the unmapped share are reported. The plan closes with a report carrying fit diagnostics (MA and dispersion plots), the p-value histogram, the shrunken and unshrunken log2FC, leading-edge genes per significant set, the low-depth-sample findings, and the reproducibility record.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: vst(blind), PCA, sample distances, library sizes

DESeq2 design ~ condition with explicit reference level
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic with MSigDB Hallmark
Differential expression report with fit diagnostics, robustness overlap, and reproducibility record
